releaseNotes: v17.17.0: Adds the pink 'Бункер виживання' navigation group. Survival Ops and Bunker share one inventory, parts, raid kits, medkits, rare loot, profile coins, XP and Royale Pass XP. Successful raids deposit loot; craft kits in Bunker for 3 parts, use kits/medkits in Survival Ops, and exchange rare loot for +75 coins and +20 XP.
